newsitem.title: USA: Computer Sciences gets expanded contract.
newsitem.headline: Computer Sciences gets expanded contract.

text.p: Computer Sciences Corp said it has been awarded a new expanded outsourcing contract worth more than $377 million over six years by the insurance company Australian Mutual Provident Society.
The new contract expands the range of services covered by the original contract signed between the two companies in November 1993, Computer Sciences said.

Under the deal, AMP will pay for the services it receives according to the value they provide. Each year benchmarks will be established comparing CSC's services against leading providers of similar outsourcing services to ensure AMP has a basis for a competitive price structure, the company said.
Under the contract, CSC Australia will provide all mainframe and mid-range data processing and desktop services to AMP in Australia.

CSC Australia will also purchase, operate and upgrade AMP's wide area network, the Corporate Communications Utility, which provides communications to offices throughout Australia and has links to AMP locations around the world.
